title: "Adopt Don't Shop"
---

![](https://moderndogmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/PuppyMilestones_bs-366740632_Piyawat-Nandeenopparit-940x640.jpg)

Did you ever want to get a dog or cat but don't know where to start? We made it easy for you! Through our website you will find resources on animal shelters for you to adopt from in Tompkins County, facts on why adoption is better than buying from a breeder, and basic how to care for a pet 101.
